title: Lenvatinib in Combination With Camrelizumab as First-Line Therapy in Patients With Advanced HCC
brief_summary: This is a single arm, open-label, non-randomized and single-center phase I/II clinical study, to evaluate the the safety, tolerance and efficacy of Lenvatinib plus Camrelizumab as first-line therapy in patients with advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
